tools.name: sprint_summary
tools.description: One sprint as the Sprint Summary view counts it: delivered items and points, cycle time, carryover, and commitment (committed at the end of day one, completed of committed, reliability, scope added and removed). Reads only numbers, dates, states and ids; never titles, descriptions, comments, tags or people, and never calls Baytek. Uses the customer’s saved workflow mapping only; no mapping answers {"error":"workflow-not-mapped"}.

sprintId.description: Iteration GUID. Default: the last finished sprint (a running sprint is never summarised by default).

tools.name: cycle_time
tools.description: Cycle time over the last N finished sprints, as the Cycle Time view plots it: count, average, p50/p70/p85/p95 days, per Item Types category, slowest ids. Reads only numbers, dates, states and ids; never titles, descriptions, comments, tags or people, and never calls Baytek. Uses the customer’s saved workflow mapping only; no mapping answers {"error":"workflow-not-mapped"}.

sprints.description: How many finished sprints (default 6). Never the running one.

tools.name: flow_efficiency
tools.description: Flow efficiency over the last N finished sprints, as the Flow Efficiency view computes it. Reads only numbers, dates, states and ids; never titles, descriptions, comments, tags or people, and never calls Baytek. Uses the customer’s saved workflow mapping only; no mapping answers {"error":"workflow-not-mapped"}.

sprints.description: How many finished sprints (default 6). Never the running one.

tools.name: wip
tools.description: Items in progress right now in the running sprint, by workflow stage, with this person’s saved WIP limit. Reads only numbers, dates, states and ids; never titles, descriptions, comments, tags or people, and never calls Baytek. Uses the customer’s saved workflow mapping only; no mapping answers {"error":"workflow-not-mapped"}.

tools.name: aging
tools.description: Open work in the current sprint as the Aging view lists it, carried-over items from the previous sprint included: per item its stage, days in that stage and days in flow, in the weekend basis the Aging view uses for this person (weekendBasis says which). Reads only numbers, dates, states and ids; never titles, descriptions, comments, tags or people, and never calls Baytek. Uses the customer’s saved workflow mapping only; no mapping answers {"error":"workflow-not-mapped"}.

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Monte Carlo forecast from the last 12 sprints’ throughput: how many items in a window, or when a backlog finishes. Reads only numbers, dates, states and ids; never titles, descriptions, comments, tags or people, and never calls Baytek. Uses the customer’s saved workflow mapping only; no mapping answers {"error":"workflow-not-mapped"}.

backlog.description: when: number of items to finish.
